feed.title: Business News - Markets reports and financial news from Sky

articles.title: How to challenge your council tax band - and potentially get £100 energy payout
articles.summary: Are you missing out on the government's £100 energy payment due to being in the wrong council tax band?

articles.title: Poundland supplier urges 'thorough' state probe into owner's conduct
articles.summary: A major Poundland supplier has urged the government to "thoroughly investigate" the conduct of its majority owner as the discount chain teeters on the brink of collapse.

articles.title: Residential property manager Supa lands £20m funding boost
articles.summary: A company which has amassed a residential property management portfolio of more than 20,000 homes has landed tens of millions of pounds in funding to back its use of technology across an industry which has long resisted it.

articles.title: Wall Street edges higher after Democrats sweep midterms
articles.summary: Wall Street markets rose on Wednesday, reversing sharp early losses as Democrats continue to gain ground in the US midterm elections.

articles.title: US Olympic movement explores sale of stake in Team USA commercial rights
articles.summary: The US Olympic & Paralympic Committee (USOPC) has kicked off talks with investors about a potential deal which could involve selling a stake in the commercial rights to Team USA ahead of a crucial sporting decade for the country.

articles.title: Airlines warn budget raid will drive up passenger fares
articles.summary: Britain's leading airlines have warned the government that a little-noticed budget measure risks pushing up airfares for passengers.

articles.title: Virgin Media O2 to cut thousands of jobs in bid to reduce costs
articles.summary: Virgin Media ‌O2 (VMO2) is set to cut thousands of jobs, as it looks to save around £300m through "a reduction in the size of the workforce".

articles.title: Under-fire Poundland owner Gordon Brothers defends stewardship
articles.summary: Poundland's controlling shareholder has told the government it stands by its stewardship record even as it faces mounting pressure over the crisis which has left the discount retailer on the brink of administration.

articles.title: Prepare for cyber attacks or face empty shelves, businesses told
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence is "helping to industrialise cyber attacks" and is "highly likely" to be used in attacks on Britain's critical national infrastructure by 2028, the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) has warned.

articles.title: Major business group calls for fundamental change in UK-EU relationship
articles.summary: A major UK business group has called on the government to "fundamentally reassess" the country's relationship with the EU, as it said the current system is still "failing to deliver".
